item.text: 我会按你给的精确路径移动整个 segment 目录，只检查移动结果和 `segment.md` 的 id，不读取或触碰任何 `.reo` 路径。

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "set -euo pipefail
src='$DRAFT_ROOT/memories/mem_system_draft--草稿/segments/seg_cross_space_codex_supp_source_20260609221232--Codex Supplement Source 20260609221232'
dest_parent='$TEST_ROOT/memories/mem_codex_dogfood_17800058--Codex Dogfood Memory 17800058/segments'
base="'$(basename "$src")
dest="$dest_parent/$base"
if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
  printf '"'ERROR source_missing_before_move=%s\\n' \""'$src"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -d "$dest_parent" ]; then
  printf '"'ERROR target_parent_missing=%s\\n' \""'$dest_parent"
  exit 1
fi
if [ -e "$dest" ]; then
  printf '"'ERROR target_already_exists=%s\\n' \""'$dest"
  exit 1
fi
mv "$src" "$dest_parent/"
source_exists=no
[ -e "$src" ] && source_exists=yes
target_exists=no
[ -d "$dest" ] && target_exists=yes
segment_id=$(awk -F'"': *' '"'$1 == "id" {print $2; exit}'"' \""'$dest/segment.md")
printf '"'source_exists=%s\\n' \""'$source_exists"
printf '"'target_exists=%s\\n' \""'$target_exists"
printf '"'segment_id=%s\\n' \""'$segment_id"
printf '"'dot_reo_touched=no\\n'"
